The '''Legionnaire Academy''' was a facility constructed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lettow]] by Legionnaire [[General/Legends|general]], [[Xendor]], as a place where he and like-minded scholars could study the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Bogan]] and other Force-traditions free of interlopers from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==History==
Constructed sometime in the [[24,500 BBY|24,500s BBY]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Renunciate [[Xendor]], the academy was erected on the planet [[Lettow]] far from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. Home to Xendor and his acolytes, who called themselves the [[Legions of Lettow]], the academy's curriculum focused on Force-traditions such as the [[Order of Dai Bendu]], the [[Followers of Palawa]], the [[Kashi Mer]], the [[Baran Do]], and the [[Chatos Academy]]. Xendor's academy drew a trickle of interest which quickly transformed into a roaring river. When the High Council declared war on the schismatics, the Legionnaires were forced into a long, drawn out war on many fronts. As the conflict known as the [[First Great Schism]] raged on, Xendor was cut down at the [[Battle of Columus|battle]] of [[Columus/Legends|Columus]] and signaled the nearing of the end. Those who remained at the academy were targeted by the Jedi Order's army and its leader, [[Awdrysta Pina]]. Holding back the attackers until all surviving Legionnaires could flee the planet, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Pina sacked the academy and left it in ruins.<ref name="TEGTW" />
